I understand that a salon in a mall needs to make money, but the clients that can actually become loyal customers with great service is a must have requirement. We won’t mind paying your ridiculous price range if your services were impeccable. But pathetic service and high prices that is simply unjustified.

I have attached the photo of what my mom wanted. What she got for Rs. 3500/- is an extremely basic Cateye. Might just go to a nearby nail salon and get redone again.

Waste of money, waste of time and a completely unsatisfactory experience.
